images.prompt: A dark small room at night: an old 1980s shortwave radio receiver on a wooden table, only its tuning dial glows a faint cold green, an empty chair beside it, a black window behind; dial markings blurred and unreadable.

A snowy dark pine forest at night in remote Russia: several tall steel radio antenna masts rising above the trees, a single small red warning light at the top of one mast, heavy silence, nobody there. No flags, no signs, no military markings.
Extreme close-up of the speaker grille of an old shortwave radio in darkness, the faint green glow of the tuning needle beside it, tiny dust particles trembling in the light.

A bare grey concrete room lit by one hanging bulb: an old desk with a vintage microphone on a stand facing an empty chair, cables on the floor, a heavy metal door closed. No flags, no signs, no uniforms.

A long dark concrete corridor; at its far end a heavy door stands slightly ajar with a thin line of warm light; inside, far away and blurred, two small faceless silhouettes sit near a microphone stand. Unsettling, quiet. No uniforms, no signs.

A dark small concrete room: an empty wooden chair pulled back from a desk with an old microphone on a stand, a single desk lamp, a half-full glass of tea on the desk, the door behind open onto blackness, as if someone has just stepped away. No signs, no text, no uniforms.
